claims: Manchester City defeated Tottenham Hotspur 5-2 on March 21, 2026 in a Women's Super League clash.
Khadija "Bunny" Shaw scored a record-setting 21-minute hat-trick.
Khadija Shaw scored 3 goals for Manchester City.
A. Nilden scored an own goal for Manchester City.
Tottenham Hotspur scorers included B. England.
Reuters reports that this win moved Manchester City eight points clear at the top of the WSL table.
Tottenham Hotspur notes the match was a Saturday lunchtime kickoff at the Joie Stadium.
Manchester City and Tottenham Hotspur drew 2-2 in February 2026 in 2025-26 Premier League action.
ESPN notes that Dominic Solanke's brace rescued a point for Spurs.
